scope: All 16 actual public production screenshots, individually opened and rehashed. Strict public run passed with source and dist unchanged.
reviewMethod: All 16 original production Chromium screenshots were individually displayed using view_image. No new image retouch, CSS, scene, pose, state or harness injection. Capture hashes were checked against the final production report.

limitations: Prepared Node-native prior story completion is declared in fixture metadata; it is not claimed as played.
One ordinary tactical command was played on Therum formation0, not a complete mission victory or vehicle combat.
Mako physics and four fixed direction drawings remain a bounded 2D adaptation without jump, turret aiming, vehicle arsenal, hull damage, repair or wheel animation.
Some screenshots include transient native toasts; long map lists are vertically scrollable.
Desktop/mobile Chromium viewports are not physical device performance evidence or certification of original-game 1:1 geography, designs or motion.
